claims: Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida
The Artemis II mission used the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket to propel the Orion spacecraft
The Orion spacecraft carried four astronauts
Artemis II was a lunar flyby mission
Artemis II launch location was Kennedy Space Center, Florida, Pad 39B
Artemis II launch date was April 1, 2026
Artemis II mission goal was the first crewed flight around the Moon since 1972
Artemis II crew was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen
Artemis II was the first crewed mission of the Artemis program
The Artemis program is designed to test the systems necessary for future deep space exploration
